questions.prompt: Who invented the printing press with movable type in Europe?
questions.fact: Movable type existed in Korea and China first; his innovation was the metal alloy and the press mechanism.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the study of fossils?
questions.fact: Archaeology studies human artefacts, which is why dinosaurs are firmly not archaeology.

questions.prompt: Which sport features the terms deuce and let?
questions.fact: A let serve clipping the net used to be judged by ear, and electronic sensors replaced that in the 1990s.

questions.prompt: Which television series is set at Hawkins Middle School?
questions.fact: Its child cast were given a book of 1980s references so they would understand what they were reacting to.

questions.prompt: Which sea lies to the west of Ireland?
questions.fact: There is no land between its west coast and Newfoundland, which is why its weather arrives without warning.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel A Suitable Boy?
questions.fact: At around 1,350 pages it is one of the longest novels ever published in a single English volume.

questions.prompt: Which company makes the Chromebook operating system?
questions.fact: It runs a Linux kernel underneath, and can now run Android and Linux applications alongside web ones.
